mechanism_fidelity.rationale: Competing copy, guard and interaction explanations are compared against selective rule removals and isolated-guard trials. Outcomes can differentially support or contradict explanations, narrowing the set without forcing a single cause. The limits retain hypothesis incompleteness, replay-specific evidence constraints and interaction uncertainty.

target_fidelity.rationale: Identifying plausible activation obstructions and interactions needing investigation is an explicitly bounded contribution to the retained question. The mapping does not claim to establish all necessary features or population-wide user necessity.

operational_coherence.rationale: The stipulated executable subsets and deterministic resets make the five proposed trials intelligible and affordable within the ledger. Their pass/fail outcomes bear on competing explanations. Testing B and D alone cannot establish their joint interaction, but the inference appropriately retains an interaction as a possibility for further inquiry.

validity.rationale: The mapping preserves differential diagnosis and supports a coherent, bounded contribution to understanding activation obstructions and dependencies.

uncertainty: Trial outcomes are not supplied, so no particular explanation can currently be favored or eliminated.
The proposed trials may leave pairwise and higher-order interactions unresolved; replay findings do not establish real-user necessity.
